caption: What to do if you miss your ex #usahealth #wellness #wellnessjourney #selflove #mentalhealth
transcript: You miss your ex. Should you reach out or should you let the silence hold? My friend, everyone will tell you to just text them or everyone will tell you never look back. But listen carefully. Missing someone is not proof that they belonged with you. It is only proof that your heart remembers warmth. And warmth is easy to remember, even from a fire that burned you. Ask yourself this. Do you miss them? Or do you miss who you were when you were with them? Because those are not the same person and only one of them is gone forever. Think of a house you once lived in. You can miss the house, the light in the kitchen, the sound of the door. But missing it does not mean you should move back in. Some houses were only right for the season you were in. So before you reach out, ask your body one question. If they said yes to everything, would I feel peace or would I feel the same weight I left with? The body always knows, because some people are not meant to be returned to. They were only ever meant to be learned from. And you already learned what you came there to learn.
